description: With no GPS on Mars and up to 22-minute signal delays to Earth, astronauts cannot rely on remote mission control. MartisDux solves this by unifying scattered orbital data into an offline mission guide. It layers terrain, slope hazards, and science targets onto one map, while using AR and VR for 3D tabletop route planning and virtual walks. Complete with landing simulations to test safe touchdown zones and local logging for field records, it helps crews explore Mars safely and autonomously.
